meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器完成测试、填表、截图和数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动化浏览器操作来完成测试或数据采集
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions for testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate browser tasks like testing, form filling, or data extraction

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能按指令操作真实浏览器:打开网址、查看页面上的可交互元素、点击、填表、输入文字,还能截图、存 PDF、提取页面文本或 HTML、录制视频等。
howto.when: 当用户需要访问网站、操作网页、填表、截图、测试 Web 应用或从网页提取信息时触发。

say.text: 打开 example.com 并截一张整页长图。
say.note: 会执行 open 和 screenshot --full。

say.text: 帮我把登录页的用户名和密码填好并提交。
say.note: 先 snapshot 定位,再 fill 和 click。

say.text: 提取这个页面上所有链接的地址。
say.note: 用 get attr 取 href。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can drive a real browser: open URLs, list interactive elements on a page, click, fill forms, type, take screenshots, save PDFs, extract text/HTML/attributes, and record videos.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs to visit a website, interact with a web page, fill out forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a full-page screenshot.
Fill in the username and password on the login form and submit it.
say_en.note: Snapshots the form, fills refs, clicks submit.

say_en.text: Extract all link URLs from this page.
say_en.note: Uses get attr to collect hrefs.
